entities.summary: Skoglar Toste or Skoglar Tosti is a legendary 10th century chieftain from the Swedish province of West Gothland. Snorri Sturlusson recounts in Heimskringla that he was a great Viking who often waged war and that is why he was called "Skagul's Tosti". Skagul was a Valkyrie.
